title: Hourglass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- top plate -->
  <rect x='25' y='8' width='50' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- bottom plate -->
  <rect x='25' y='84' width='50' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- glass body outer shape -->
  <path d='M30 16 C30 40, 46 46, 46 50 C46 54, 30 60, 30 84 L70 84 C70 60, 54 54, 54 50 C54 46, 70 40, 70 16 Z' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <!-- glass highlight left -->
  <path d='M35 20 C35 38, 47 45, 47 50 C47 55, 35 62, 35 80' stroke='#e0f7ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top sand -->
  <path d='M33 18 L67 18 C67 34, 56 44, 52 48 L48 48 C44 44, 33 34, 33 18 Z' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- bottom sand -->
  <path d='M33 82 L48 60 L52 60 L67 82 Z' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- falling sand stream -->
  <rect x='48' y='48' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- face on left area -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='30' r='3' fill='#2d6a8f'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='30' r='3' fill='#2d6a8f'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 38 Q50 46, 58 38' stroke='#2d6a8f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little sparkle eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- wood side posts -->
  <rect x='27' y='14' width='3' height='72' rx='1.5' fill='#d78e3c'/>
  <rect x='70' y='14' width='3' height='72' rx='1.5' fill='#d78e3c'/>
</svg>
